notes.title: After their publisher was banned from Steam, Bioprototype returns and it's free
notes.notes:
Sometime in 2024 a publisher called BD Games was banned from Steam, taking with it numerous smaller games. Bioprototype from Emprom Game recently returned to Steam without a publisher, and it's free to claim and keep for a while.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/05/after-their-publisher-was-banned-from-steam-bioprototype-returns-and-its-free/

notes.title: Brotato style roguelike Bioprototype returns to Steam, and you can get it free
notes.notes:
If you enjoy games like Vampire Survivors and Brotato, then mutating horde-survival roguelike Bioprototype is worth a look. With 24 unique characters, more than 80 organs, and the ability to adjust your own skill triggers, it offers a tremendous amount of build variety wrapped in a distinctive, fleshy theme. If you crave a little more depth and strategy while retaining the core of the auto-attacking format, Bioprototype has just returned to Steam, and you can get it completely free if you add it to your account in the next few weeks.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Free Access to Bioprototype & Our Apology
notes.notes:
[b]Dear players,[/b]

We sincerely apologize to all fans of Bioprototype. The game was removed due to the publisher’s policy violations on Steam, and the compensation plan did not meet your expectations. Below is the full story and our new solutions.

[h1]1.Cause and Responsibility of the Incident [/h1]

[h2]1. The reason of the removal[/h2]

●Bioprototype was developed by our team and published globally by a publisher company BD Games.

●In [b]early 2024[/b], the publisher broke Steam rules. Since we're not the administrater of the publisher team, we're unable to know the details of the violation. As a result, their Steam account was permanently banned, and all games they published (including ours) were removed forever.

●[b]This violation had nothing to do with our team or Bioprototype[/b], but Steam required all games cooperated with the account to be removed.

●[b]Important Notice[/b]: The removal only affects Bioprototype. Its sequel Bioweaver is a new project, [b]NOT a renamed version of Bioprototype[/b]. We regret that some players mistakenly believed the still-available Bioweaver to be a rebranded Bioprototype. We hereby confirm the two are separate entries in the same series.

[h2]2. Our Mistakes[/h2]

●[b]We failed to check risks in the publisher partnership[/b] and didn’t draft any legal provisions against publisher's violations.

●[b]We handled the crisis poorly[/b]: From June 2024 to the present, in order to maintain the basic operating funds of the company, we chose to focus on developing the new project and entrusted an outsourcing service agency to handle over 100,000 players' key requests manually. During this period, we hoped to explain the situation to Steam to restore the game and communicated with the official through various channels multiple times, but were ultimately rejected. These wrong measures lead to the untimely or missing issuance of keys. 

○Early on, we forced players into an Epic key solution due to Steam’s key limit (only 2,000 keys allowed). We ignored that many players prefer Steam, and this decision was careless. We are truly sorry.

[h1]2. The Reason Why Solutions Were Delayed[/h1]

●We signed [b]Anti-price discrimination Agreements with the publisher on other platforms[/b] before the incident. If we had released Bioprototype for free at any time, we would have faced legal action and heavy penalties.

●This was another mistake in our risk management—[b]failing to foresee how these contracts would limit our response during a crisis.[/b]

[h1]3. Current Solutions[/h1]

[h2]1. Free Access & Compensation[/h2]

●Bioprototype will [b]return to Steam for free for 2 months (May 20–July 20). All players can add it to the library.[/b]
[b]Add to Library[/b]: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3689520/_/

[h2]2. Discount for Bio-Series Bundle[/h2]

●Everyone who claims Bioprototype during the free period will get an [b]20% OFF for the Bio-Series bundle[/b]. This offer works forever when buying the bundle.

[h1]4. Acknowledgments[/h1]

Thank you to every player who criticized us, gave advice. Your feedback helped improve our games. If you have any comment, feel free to reach us via Discord or Steam Community.
